title: COMPUTATIONAL EDIT / WORLD MEMORY LINK
principle: COMPUTATION TRANSFORMS INHERITED WORLD MATERIAL; IT DOES NOT DECORATE AN EMPTY CANVAS.

inputs.role: current location, active encounter, scale and continuity
visual sequence, temporal memory, core gesture and return-to-origin

transformationContract.read: Load current world state and visual memory before choosing a transformation.
transformationContract.record: Store source state, deterministic seed, transformation parameters, and resulting artifact together.
transformationContract.return: The next run begins from the latest recorded result, not from a blank scene.

initialPrototype: The procedural canvas is the first rendering surface. It currently uses seeded geometry and pointer-responsive framing; direct asset ingestion and persistence remain the next implementation stage.
nextImplementation: Bind the canvas to world-state.json and visual_memory.json, then derive the next render from the active encounter and visual-memory sequence.
